verdict.outcome_rationale: This was a genuine agent-fault failure and the verifier’s FAIL is correct. The hidden grader read `1.05` from `/workspace/answer.txt`, compared it to the ground-truth band 0.74–0.77 inclusive, and awarded reward 0.0 [1]. The prompt required an ordinal logistic regression odds ratio for `expect_interact_cat` on higher COVID-19 `AESEV`, adjusting for `patients_seen_cat` and `TRTGRP_cat`, written as a single number to `/workspace/answer.txt` [2], and the reference answer for that analysis is in the 0.74–0.77 range (reference solution writes 0.74) [3]. The agent did run ordered-logit models on COVID adverse-event rows merged with demographics, but it kept all 224 `covid|sars` AEPT event records (including asymptomatic and test-positive terms), noted 197 unique subjects yet still modeled at event level with n=176 complete cases [4][5], then switched from a numeric `patients_seen_cat` specification (OR ≈ 0.99) to categorical dummy coding because of the `_cat` suffix and accepted R `polr` output OR = 1.0464589 [6][7]. It rounded that to `1.05` and wrote it as the final answer [8]. That submitted value is well outside the accepted band and does not match the task’s intended result, so the task was not truly solved and TN (verifier fail, genuinely not solved) is the right classification.
